notes: Official JBL Professional spec sheet (issued 10/2021) confirms rear-panel layout via photo: two XLR/TRS combo input jacks labeled "CH1" and "CH2" (female, balanced/unbalanced, input impedance 50k/100k, gain -inf to +36dB), plus one male XLR "PASS THRU" output for daisy-chaining. AC power inlet connector type is not explicitly named in the spec sheet (only "AC Power Input: 100V-120V or 220V-240V" is given); corroborated as an IEC C13/C14 inlet via third-party replacement power cord listings for this model (widely sold as standard IEC/C13 3-prong cords). No USB port exists on this unit. Bluetooth 5.0 is present for audio streaming/app control but is wireless, not a physical port, so it is omitted from the physical I/O list per task scope. No grade applies to any port (XLR analog audio and IEC power are not bandwidth-graded connector types). Desktop/portable powered loudspeaker — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted.

ports.name: CH1
